title: Helping at home
topic: What can we do to help at home?

abilities.desc: I can ask about people's jobs.

items: 指着家庭树 grandpa/mum/uncle 三人，自己问 What's your ___'s job? 并自己答 He's/She's a/an ___.

abilities.desc: I can say what I do with my family.

items: 看 3 张家庭活动图，用 We often ___. / I can ___. 说出 3 句.

abilities.desc: I can talk about how to help my family.

items: 说出 I can ___ and ___. 至少 2 个组合.

abilities.desc: I can read and spell words with ch.

items: 指认 6 个 ch 词朗读 + 听写 3 个词

original.text: Can you help? Yes, I can. I can clean my room.
original.zh: 你能帮忙吗？是的，我能。我能打扫我的房间。

complete.text: Can she help? Yes, she can. She can do some chores.
complete.zh: 她能帮忙吗？是的，她能。她会做家务。

complete.text: Can he help? Yes, he can. He can sweep the floor.
complete.zh: 他能帮忙吗？是的，他能。他会扫地。

extend.text: Can they help? Yes, they can. They can cook dinner.
extend.zh: 他们能帮忙吗？是的，他们能。他们会做晚饭。

extend.text: Can Dad help? Yes, he can. He can draw a picture.
extend.zh: 爸爸能帮忙吗？是的，他能。他会画画。

quiz.image_prompt: 一个小女孩举起右手做提问姿势，表情好奇，身旁有三张家务小图（扫地/擦桌/叠衣），扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字

method_card.visual: Can [谁] help? Yes, [谁] can. [谁] can [做什么].
method_card.script: 一个句子 = 三个口袋：谁、能、做什么。换主语（he/she/we）和动作，就是新句子。

produce_tasks.image_prompt: 奶奶在照顾小妹妹（婴儿），神情温柔，扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字
produce_tasks.expect: Can Grandma help? Yes, she can. She can look after my sister.

tutor.instruction: 现在你来教爸爸：用 Can…help? 问他，再教他回答。

original.text: What's your father's job? He's a factory worker.
original.zh: 你爸爸做什么工作？他是工厂工人。

complete.text: What's your grandpa's job? He's a farmer.
complete.zh: 你爷爷做什么工作？他是农民。

complete.text: What's your grandma's job? She's a nurse.
complete.zh: 你奶奶做什么工作？她是护士。

complete.text: What's your mother's job? She's an office worker.
complete.zh: 你妈妈做什么工作？她是办公室职员。

extend.text: What's your uncle's job? He's a teacher.
extend.zh: 你叔叔做什么工作？他是老师。

extend.text: What's your aunt's job? She's a writer.
extend.zh: 你阿姨做什么工作？她是作家。

extend.text: My father is a busy doctor.
extend.zh: 我爸爸是一位忙碌的医生。

quiz.image_prompt: 家庭树局部图，爷爷头像，下方配空横线，扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字
quiz.prompt: What's your grandpa's job? He's a ___.

method_card.visual: What's your [谁]'s job? He's/She's a/an [职业].
method_card.script: 两个口袋：[谁] 和 [职业]。把爸爸换成爷爷、工厂工人换成农民，就得到新句子。

produce_tasks.image_prompt: 阿姨（年轻女士）坐在书桌前写作，桌上笔记本电脑和稿纸，扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字
produce_tasks.expect: What's your aunt's job? She's a writer.

tutor.instruction: 现在你来教妈妈：指着家庭树，问一个人的工作，再教她回答。

original.text: What can we do for them? We can do some chores.
original.zh: 我们能为他们做什么？我们可以做家务。

complete.text: I can cook and clean the room.
I can sweep the floor and make a gift.

extend.text: I can cook for my family.
We can draw pictures with my mum.
extend.zh: 我们会和妈妈一起画画。

quiz.image_prompt: 两个动作卡（炒菜+擦桌子）用加号连接，扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字

method_card.script: 两个动作连起来，and 像胶水。选任意两个动作卡，连成新句子。

produce_tasks.image_prompt: 孩子抱着小妹妹轻轻唱歌，旁边有音符装饰，扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字
produce_tasks.expect: I can look after my sister and sing.

tutor.instruction: 现在你来教爸爸：选两个动作，教他连成一句话。

segments.image_prompt: 空白家庭海报模板底图，中间一家人像框，四周留白槽位，扁平卡通，圆角白底，无文字

method_card.script: 从每张卡片选一张，连成海报句子。先自己造，再从补全句库对照补足。

original.text: My grandma can make good lunches.
original.zh: 我奶奶会做好吃的午饭。

extend.text: The teacher teaches children in China.
I eat lunch with my grandma in the kitchen.
extend.zh: 我和奶奶在厨房吃午饭。

quiz.image_prompt: 一盘热腾腾的午饭，扁平卡通，圆角白底词图，无文字

original.text: Mum is also a great cook.
We can help her at home.

extend.text: I want to help her at home.
I can sweep the floor and clean the room.
